title: 第25章 厚积薄发第26章 私塾规划
content_zh:
黎监院的那袭紫袍早已消失在回廊尽头，听雨轩内那股因“敕令”而起的燥热却并未随之散去。
胡教习重新坐回了蒲团之上，拿起那卷未讲完的《大周律》，声音依旧平稳金石，继续剖析着为官之道。
只是，这后半堂课，真正能听进去的人，已是寥寥。
轩内的空气仿佛变得粘稠起来，无数道视线像是被磁石牵引的铁屑，若有若无、并不掩饰却又极尽含蓄地落在后排那个角落。
那个角落里坐着的，是苏秦。
他依旧是一袭青衫，脊背挺得笔直。
手中握着狼毫，在纸上不疾不徐地做着笔记，仿佛刚才那一场足以震动整个外舍的嘉奖，与他毫无干系。
然而，在周围人的眼中，那个曾经面目模糊、仅靠着“三年水磨工夫”才勉强挤进内舍的“老资历”苏师兄，正在一点点破碎、重组。
赵猛坐在斜前方，身子半侧着，眼角的余光一遍遍扫过苏秦。
他忽然觉得，苏秦那袖口上沾染的一点泥渍，不再是寒酸与落魄的象征，反而透着一股子“知行合一”的高深莫测。
那是真的下过田、吃过苦、并在泥泞中悟出大道的痕迹。
“这就是所谓的‘大智若愚’么……”
赵猛心中喃喃，下意识地挺了挺自己有些弯曲的脊背，试图模仿苏秦那份从容的坐姿，却只觉得浑身僵硬。
不仅仅是他。
周围的学子们，无论是平日里眼高于顶的世家子，还是那些谨小慎微的寒门生，此刻看向苏秦的目光中，都多了一层名为“审视”的厚重。
仿佛头一次认识了这位，在记忆中本渐渐模糊的‘师兄’。
苏秦这个名字，头一次在他们记忆中，如此清晰的留下了印记。
“笃。”
一声清脆的木石撞击声响起。
胡教习合上了手中的书卷，目光扫过轩外那毒辣的日头。

“今日的课，便讲到这里。”
众学子如梦初醒，纷纷起身收拾笔墨，动作间却比往日多了几分迟疑，似乎都在等着看些什么。
胡教习并未像往常那般化作墨痕遁入画中，也没有起身离去。
他端起茶盏，轻轻撇去浮沫，目光越过前排那些还未散去的精英弟子，径直看向了讲台左侧。
那个位置，依旧空着。
深色的蒲团上落了几粒微尘，显得有些冷清。
那是属于林清寒的位置。
胡教习的视线在那里停留了一瞬，眼底闪过一丝微不可查的叹息，随即，他的目光一转，落在了后排正在整理行囊的苏秦身上。
“苏秦。”
胡教习的声音并不高，却清晰地穿透了轩内的嘈杂。
苏秦动作一顿，抬起头来，恭敬行礼
“学生在。”
胡教习放下茶盏，那张平日里总是板着、如同门神般严肃的脸上，此刻竟舒展了几分，语气平淡得就像是在说一件再寻常不过的小事
“你若无其他急事，便随我来。
老夫前日得了一罐雨前龙井，正好与你讲讲那《春风化雨》中，关于‘润’字诀的几处关窍。”
此言一出，正准备离去的众学子脚步齐齐一顿。
轩内陷入了短暂的死寂。
一种“果然如此”的氛围，在空气中弥漫开来。
大家看看那个空荡荡的深色蒲团，再看看正垂手而立的苏秦，心中只生出一个念头——理所应当。
content_en:
The purple robe of the Li Supervisor has long since disappeared at the end of the corridor, but the heat in Tingyuxuan caused by the "order" has not dissipated.
Hu Jiaoxi sat back on the futon and picked up the unfinished volume of "Dazhou Law". His voice was still calm and steady, and he continued to analyze the way to be an official.
However, in the second half of the class, only a few people could really listen.
The air in the pavilion seemed to have become thicker, and countless lines of sight were like iron filings pulled by magnets, falling on the corner of the back row indistinctly, without concealing it but with utmost subtlety.
Sitting in that corner was Su Qin.
He was still wearing a green shirt and his back was straight.
Holding the wolf hair in his hand, he was taking notes on the paper slowly, as if the award just now that shocked the entire outer house had nothing to do with him.
However, in the eyes of the people around him, the "veteran seniority" Brother Su, who was once vague and barely managed to squeeze into the inner house with "three years of hard work", is being broken and reorganized bit by bit.
Zhao Meng sat diagonally in front of him, his body half turned sideways, and the corner of his eye glanced at Su Qin over and over again.
He suddenly felt that the mud stain on Su Qin's cuffs was no longer a symbol of shabbiness and abjection, but instead revealed an unfathomable sense of "unity of knowledge and action".
Those are the traces of having really worked in the fields, endured hardships, and realized the great way in the mud.
"Is this the so-called 'great wisdom but foolishness'..."
Zhao Meng murmured in his heart, subconsciously straightening his somewhat curved back, trying to imitate Su Qin's calm sitting posture, but he only felt stiff all over.
It's not just him.
The students around him, whether they were those from aristocratic families who usually had high-mindedness, or those who were cautious and humble, all looked at Su Qin with a layer of "scrutiny" in their eyes.
It was as if I had met this ‘senior brother’ for the first time, whose memory was gradually blurring.
For the first time, the name Su Qin left such a clear imprint in their memories.
"Attsu."
There was a clear sound of impacting wood and stone.
Hu Jiaoxi closed the book in his hand and glanced at the vicious sun outside the building.
"That's the end of today's lesson."
All the students woke up from a dream and stood up to put away their pens and ink. However, their movements were a little more hesitant than before, as if they were waiting to see something.
Hu Jiaoxi did not turn into ink marks and escape into the painting as usual, nor did he get up and leave.
He picked up the tea cup, gently skimmed off the foam, looked past the elite disciples in the front row who had not dispersed, and looked directly to the left side of the podium.
That position is still vacant.
A few specks of dust fell on the dark futon, which looked a little deserted.
That was Lin Qinghan's position.
Hu Jiaoxi's gaze stayed there for a moment, and a subtle sigh flashed in his eyes. Then, his gaze turned and fell on Su Qin who was packing his luggage in the back row.
"Su Qin."
Hu Jiaoxi's voice was not loud, but it clearly penetrated the noise in the hall.
Su Qin paused, raised his head, and saluted respectfully.
"The students are here."
Hu Jiaoxi put down the tea cup. His face, which was usually as serious as a door god, relaxed a bit at this moment, and his tone was as calm as if he was talking about an ordinary trivial matter.
"If you have no other urgent matters, just come with me.
I got a jar of Yuqian Longjing the day before yesterday, and I just want to tell you a few key points about the word "moistening" in "Spring Breeze Turns into Rain". "
As soon as these words came out, all the students who were about to leave stopped in unison.
Xuan Nei fell into a brief dead silence.
An atmosphere of "Sure enough" filled the air.
Everyone looked at the empty dark futon, and then at Su Qin who was standing with his hands down, and only one thought came to his mind - it should be taken for granted.
